oauth: Open Creatif Space and go to Channels.
You're back in Channels with the account listed.
page_picker: Open Creatif Space and go to Channels.
If you manage more than one page, choose the pages to connect.
You're back in Channels with the account listed.
bluesky: Open Creatif Space and go to Channels.
Enter your Bluesky handle and an app password (Bluesky has no sign-in page to send you to).
You're back in Channels with the account listed.

requirements.text: Room on your plan: Free connects up to 3 social accounts; Pro and Max have no limit.

oauth_requirements.text: Finish the sign-in within 30 minutes of starting it.
You'll be asked which account to use, so you can pick a different one from the one your browser is signed in to.

common_errors.text: "Free connects up to 3 social accounts." Disconnect one or upgrade to Pro or Max.
"Connecting {network} isn't available right now — our team has been alerted." Try again later.
Later, "{network} needs you to reconnect this account in Creatif Space → Channels." The network's access expired; connect it again.

oauth_common_errors.text: "The permissions were not granted, so nothing was connected." Connect again and allow access.
"The sign-in expired." or "That sign-in link is not valid any more." Start the connect again from Channels.
"The sign-in was cancelled." Connect again when you're ready.
"This account is already connected to another Creatif Space account." The same account can be in only one workspace.
"The sign-in finished, but no account came back from it." Connect again and pick the account on the network's page.
"We couldn't confirm the connection just now." Refresh Channels in a minute.

requirements.text: Allow every permission Instagram asks for, including messages: Engage for Instagram covers DMs and comments.
Replies to a DM must go out within 24 hours of the person's last message.

common_errors.text: "Reconnect this Instagram account to allow messages." The account was connected without the messages permission; connect it again and allow it.
"Instagram only allows a reply within 24 hours of their last message." Wait for them to message again.
"Instagram allows a private reply only within 7 days of the comment."

requirements.text: A Facebook Page to connect. After sign-in you choose the Page; each Page you choose counts as one account on your plan.
Engage for Facebook covers comments (not DMs).

common_errors.text: "That sign-in expired. Connect again." The Page choice waits 30 minutes.
"Your plan connects up to 3 social accounts. Choose fewer, or upgrade to add more."

requirements.text: After sign-in you choose which LinkedIn pages to connect; each one you choose counts as one account on your plan.

common_errors.text: "That sign-in expired. Connect again." The page choice waits 30 minutes.
"Your plan connects up to 3 social accounts. Choose fewer, or upgrade to add more."

notes.text: Deleting a post in Creatif Space leaves it on TikTok: TikTok does not let apps delete posts.
Deleting a post in Creatif Space leaves it on Threads: Threads does not let apps delete posts.

requirements.text: Every Pin goes to a board, so you'll choose one of the account's boards when you post.

common_errors.text: "Pinterest needs a board for this Pin. Choose a board and send again."
"Pinterest did not answer. Try again in a moment." The board list could not be loaded.

requirements.text: Your Bluesky handle and an app password. Bluesky has no sign-in page to send you to.

common_errors.text: "Bluesky didn't accept the connection request": usually a wrong handle or app password.
"This account cannot be claimed." A Bluesky account already in another workspace can't be moved here from Creatif Space.
